target_binary.note: GOG 1.03 PE, sha256 9c10e0450a6eeca417e036e3cde7474fed1f0a92aab018446d156944dea91435; VAs at image base 0x400000.

purpose: kp.motion Stages M1 (read-only capture) and M2 (relocate/restore/observe), K1 GOG only: the typed server placeable lookup, the position setter, the placeable vtable, and the CSWSObject/CSWSPlaceable fields the capture reads. Only the verification's 'safe to enter reviewed data' list is used. The generator reads every <alias>_*_bindings.json.

derivations.method: capstone listing camera-rederive-scratch/text.asm plus direct byte reads of the raw image with a stdlib PE reader
re-derived from text.asm before reading the receipt, independent stdlib PE reader; verdict CONFIRMS, no substantive differences

reference_image.note: file offset == RVA for .text/.rdata/.data; tools/kp_motiontest.cpp re-reads every guard and slot from it when present

accept_rule: accept requires two independent derivations of the same immediate from the raw image (the M0 receipt and its verification) plus the guard bytes read from the reference image (METHOD.md section 1). Meaning-unverified offsets carry the word unverified in their name and a limits note; their offset and extent are what is accepted.
field_shape: kind=field rows carry owner, offset and size; addr is 0 behind a pointer chain. kind=reference rows are vtable addresses compared as pointers. GetPlaceableByGameObjectID has no hooksites entry yet (proposed to the orchestrator); CSWSObject::SetPosition matches the existing server_object.set_position hooksites row.

live readback: no capture has been taken in a running game
